waterbody.studyDescription: A 5-km river within the jurisdiction of Bulusan Volcano National Park; the 2015 paper treats it as estuarine-linked.
waterbody.geometryStatus: The paper reports that station GPS positions were collected, but its taxon table gives only river-level presence marks. No station coordinate table or reusable river geometry was recovered.

citation: Corpuz, M. N. C., Paller, V. G. V., & Ocampo, P. P. (2015). Environmental variables structuring the stream gobioid assemblages in the three protected areas in Southern Luzon, Philippines. Raffles Bulletin of Zoology, 63, 357-365. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5385261

studyDesign.scope: Gobiidae and Eleotridae (gobioid fishes), not a full fish-fauna inventory.
studyDesign.samplingEffort: Twelve longitudinal stations per river, four 60-75 m stream sections sampled at each station; backpack electrofishing was primary and seine/hand nets were auxiliary. Two to three sampling days were conducted in each wet-season campaign.
studyDesign.siteTotal: Across Bulusan, Iyam and Pansipit, the paper reports 1,071 specimens in 19 table taxa. It reports 422 specimens from Bulusan and calls its Bulusan site list 10 species; that site list includes one genus-only row, Eleotris sp.
studyDesign.hydrology: The authors classify all three streams as estuarine-linked. Bulusan mean salinity is reported as 0.16 +/- 0.42 ppt in the study's habitat table; do not infer a single freshwater/brackish class for all stations.

bulusanReportedTaxa.nameNote: Table 2 spells sinesis; abstract and results prose spell Bostrychus sinensis.
Preserve this source spelling verbatim pending taxonomic verification; do not silently correct it.

interpretationLimits: The source marks presence at Bulusan River as a whole; it does not give a taxon-by-station, taxon-by-date or exact capture-coordinate crosswalk.
The survey is historical and limited to gobioids, and cannot serve as a complete or current Bulusan River fish checklist.
Eleotris sp. is not a species-level identification. Do not count it as a verified species or replace it with a guessed species.

The source's Bostrychus sinesis spelling conflicts with Bostrychus sinensis in its abstract and results prose; Oxyeleotris lineonata is retained exactly as printed pending an authoritative taxonomic resolution.
The paper says it recorded 10 Bulusan species, but one of its ten Bulusan table rows is genus-only. Treat this as 9 species-rank rows plus one unresolved genus-level taxon.
The study's total catch and relative density are survey measurements, not present-day stock abundance or catchability.

rightsStatus.sourceRegistryStatus: The source's Zenodo record declares CC BY 4.0; the publisher's current terms describe non-commercial downloading and retained publisher copyright. The authority relationship remains unresolved in the existing Iyam review.
rightsStatus.decision: Keep the extracted species rows out of the public Bangwit app until the applicable reuse grant is clarified.

nextAction: Continue Bicol inland and coastal screening by distinct waterbody and habitat units; seek Bulusan voucher/accession details and resolve the Zenodo/publisher rights question in parallel.
